_comment: Hermes daily collector allocation (50/day) driven by iotty D2C sales data, July 2026. weight = share of daily prospecting. Tier 1 = order volume (proven demand density). Tier 2 = volume + high AOV mix. Tier 3 = high-AOV outliers (multi-gang orders on low volume = whole-home installs already happening — prime integrator signal) plus remaining proven states.

tiers.why: 45% of all D2C orders. FL alone is ~2x CA (448 orders, $136k).
Solid volume; NC ($508 AOV), AZ ($512), IL ($469) show multi-gang project buying.
AL $943 AOV and WI $737 on tiny volume = whole-home orders already happening — find who's installing them. Rest are proven smaller markets.

scoring_hint: fit_score bonus: +10 state in tier 1, +7 tier 2, +5 tier 3; +10 if company site mentions Lutron/Caseta/Control4 (already sells smart controls); +5 if reviews mention renovation/custom home.
